title: A Structure-Preserving PML-Domain-Embedding Method for Acoustic Wave Scattering by Moving Objects
summary: We develop a structure-preserving computational framework for acoustic wave scattering by moving objects, comprising a new PML-domain-embedding model and a compatible numerical approximation. The model couples a perfectly matched layer (PML), used to truncate the acoustic wave equation, with a domain-embedding formulation that represents moving objects on a fixed computational domain. The resulting PML-domain-embedding (PML-DE) system enables moving-boundary scattering problems to be solved without remeshing.
